text: Karnataka Tragedy: Nine Dead As Private Bus Catches Fire After Lorry Collision In ChitradurgaIn a tragic accident in Chitradurga, Karnataka, nine people were killed when a private bus caught fire following a collision with a lorry. According to IGP Ravikanthe Gowda of Davanagere, the lorry jumped over the divider and struck the bus, causing the vehicle to ignite. #karnataka #chitradurga #busfire #roadaccident #tragicaccident #lorrycollision Times Now - Times Now News channel examines news with in-depth analysis.
